Faithful translation of the official MFDS easy_drug source used for the KO canonical — no new medical facts, no weakening of indications/contraindications/warnings, no marketing claims. eeeb3afbdc7fbee8.title: Saeromoa Capsule
eeeb3afbdc7fbee8.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used as supportive treatment for damaged hair, poor nail growth that is not caused by infection, and hair loss.
eeeb3afbdc7fbee8.usage:
Adults: take 1 capsule at a time, 3 times daily. Children aged 12 years and over: take 1 capsule at a time, 1 to 2 times daily, after meals. The average treatment period is 3 to 6 months.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
eeeb3afbdc7fbee8.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine; children under 12 years. Do not use it for hair loss caused by scarring, androgenetic hereditary alopecia, or male-pattern baldness.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: pregnant women, women who may be pregnant, and breastfeeding women.

Consult a pharmacist if you use this medicine together with sulfonamide preparations.

If gastrointestinal discomfort (stomach pain, vomiting), sweating, rapid heartbeat, itching, hives, headache, dizziness, flushing, or hair growth on parts of the body other than the head occurs, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Supportive treatment for damaged hair, poor non-infectious nail growth, and hair loss
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Damaged hair, poor nail growth, hair loss

a0df42651d724493.title: Dendris Capsule
a0df42651d724493.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used as supportive treatment for gingivitis after periodontal treatment and for mild to moderate periodontitis.
a0df42651d724493.usage:
Adults: take 1 capsule at a time, 3 times daily, after meals.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
a0df42651d724493.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: children under 15 years; patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: a history of allergic symptoms to medicines or cosmetics (rash, redness, itching); a history of allergic symptoms to eggs (fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching); an allergic constitution; hypersensitivity to Yellow No. 5 or a history of it.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if you are taking any other medicine.

If rash, redness, diarrhoea, loss of appetite, stomach discomfort, nausea, vomiting, stomatitis, or symptoms of Stevens-Johnson syndrome or toxic epidermal necrolysis (Lyell's syndrome) occur — for example fever, erythema, itching, eye congestion, stomatitis, or severe symptoms such as rash and redness with high fever over the skin of the whole body and the mucous membranes of the mouth and throat, or burn-like blistering — stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Supportive treatment for gingivitis after periodontal treatment and mild to moderate periodontitis
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Gingivitis after periodontal treatment, mild to moderate periodontitis

7ffa970ad3e1f793.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used as supportive treatment for damaged hair, poor nail growth that is not caused by infection, and hair loss.

Adults: take 1 capsule at a time, 3 times daily, after meals.

Children under 12 years must not take this medicine.

7ffa970ad3e1f793.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine; children under 12 years. Do not use it for hair loss caused by scarring, androgenetic hereditary alopecia, or male-pattern baldness.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: pregnant women, women who may be pregnant, and breastfeeding women; a history of hypersensitivity to Yellow No. 5 or of allergic reactions.

If stomach pain, vomiting or other gastrointestinal discomfort, sweating, rapid heartbeat, itching, hives, headache, dizziness, flushing, or hair growth on parts of the body other than the head occurs, or if there is no improvement after 3 to 4 months of use at the stated dose and directions, or if symptoms persist or the expected effect does not appear, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

65c686b22a3a960e.title: Melin C Tablet
65c686b22a3a960e.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to relieve pigmentation (melasma, freckles) caused by sunlight and skin conditions, to prevent bleeding gums and nosebleeds, and for physical fatigue, pregnancy, breastfeeding, and reduced physical strength during and after illness.
65c686b22a3a960e.usage:
Children aged 8 years and over and adults: take 1 tablet at a time, once daily.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
65c686b22a3a960e.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine; infants under 3 months; hypercalcaemia (excess calcium in the blood); sarcoidosis; kidney disease; kidney stones; severe renal failure.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: children who get a lot of sunlight and eat a normal diet; pregnant and breastfeeding women; patients with hyperoxaluria (excessive excretion of oxalate in the urine); hypersensitivity to Yellow No. 4 or a history of it.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

When giving this medicine to a child, do so under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.

This medicine may interfere with the detection of glucose in various urine tests.

Consult a pharmacist if you take this medicine together with cardiac glycosides.

If vomiting, nausea, diarrhoea, constipation, low blood pressure, facial flushing, irregular heartbeat, queasiness, or skin rash occurs, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Relieves pigmentation such as melasma and freckles, helps prevent bleeding gums and nosebleeds, and supports reduced physical strength
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Melasma and freckles, bleeding gums, nosebleeds, physical fatigue

0977eed528f941e8.title: Lactopol Tablet
0977eed528f941e8.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for diarrhoea, diarrhoea accompanied by abdominal pain, indigestion from overeating, loose stools, and vomiting with diarrhoea.
0977eed528f941e8.usage:
People aged 15 years and over and adults: take 2 tablets at a time, 3 times daily, after meals.
Leave an interval of at least 4 hours between doses.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
0977eed528f941e8.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: pregnant women, women who may be pregnant, and breastfeeding women; newborns; children aged 7 years and under; patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption. Do not take this medicine for more than 3 days in a row.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to Yellow No. 4 or a history of it; a history of drug allergy (fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching); gastric or duodenal ulcer; diarrhoea accompanied by fever; elderly people; bloody stools or persistent mucous stools. Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine. If symptoms do not improve after repeated doses, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

Do not take this medicine together with gastrointestinal analgesics or antispasmodics.

If allergic symptoms (rash, itching) or, rarely, a dry mouth occurs, stop using immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Relieves diarrhoea, loose stools, indigestion from overeating, and vomiting with diarrhoea
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Diarrhoea, abdominal pain, indigestion from overeating, loose stools, vomiting with diarrhoea

5c5833336f4105bc.title: Lipicle Soft Capsule
5c5833336f4105bc.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to improve high blood cholesterol and to relieve peripheral circulatory disorders accompanying it (cold hands and feet, numbness).
5c5833336f4105bc.usage:
Adults: take 2 capsules at a time, 3 times daily, after meals.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
5c5833336f4105bc.caution:
Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to Yellow No. 5 or a history of it. If symptoms do not improve after taking this medicine for about a month, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

If itching, rash, redness, loss of appetite, diarrhoea, soft stools, abdominal pain, stomach discomfort, nausea, heartburn, or queasiness occurs, or if menstruation comes earlier than expected, the flow increases, or bleeding continues for a long time, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Improves high blood cholesterol and relieves the peripheral circulatory problems that accompany it
summaryTable.Main symptoms: High blood cholesterol, cold hands and feet, numbness

b86ec051457ce436.title: Cholesten Soft Capsule
b86ec051457ce436.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to improve lipid metabolism in obesity and in diabetic or essential high blood cholesterol.
b86ec051457ce436.usage:
Take 3 capsules at a time, 3 times daily, 30 minutes before meals.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
b86ec051457ce436.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine, to soybean oil, to soy, or to peanuts.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: pregnant women and women who may be pregnant; patients with disorders of fat metabolism such as hyperlipoproteinaemia, diabetic hyperlipidaemia, or pancreatitis; patients who require careful administration of lipid emulsions; patients at particular risk from fat overload; patients predisposed to thrombosis (blocked blood vessels); hypersensitivity to Yellow No. 5 or a history of it.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

Consult a pharmacist if you use this medicine together with levodopa, oral contraceptives containing oestrogen, or intravenous lipid preparations.

Stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, constipation, rash, redness (congested and reddened skin), earlier-than-expected menstruation, or increased menstrual flow may occur. If menstrual bleeding continues for a long time, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Improves lipid metabolism in obesity and in diabetic or essential high blood cholesterol
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Obesity, high blood cholesterol, impaired lipid metabolism

246b347480652e7f.title: Chebiger Plus Tablet
246b347480652e7f.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used as supportive therapy for weight reduction through reduced food intake.
246b347480652e7f.usage:
Take 2 tablets at a time, 3 times daily before meals; if needed, 2 additional tablets may be taken before bedtime.
It is best taken with plenty of water.
Taking the recommended dose for at least 3 to 4 weeks is advised.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
246b347480652e7f.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine; infants and young children.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: pregnant and breastfeeding women; patients with digestive disorders. If symptoms do not improve after taking this medicine for a month or more, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

It is best not to take this medicine at the same time as other medicines; if you do, leaving an interval of 30 minutes to 1 hour is recommended.

If abdominal bloating, nausea, constipation, or diarrhoea occurs, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Supports weight reduction by reducing food intake
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Weight reduction support

827c2fdaa18b348c.title: Tresorix Forte Capsule
827c2fdaa18b348c.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for loss of appetite.
827c2fdaa18b348c.usage:
Adults: take 1 capsule at a time, twice daily, before breakfast and before the evening meal, for 8 days; from then on take 2 capsules at a time, twice daily, before breakfast and before the evening meal.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
827c2fdaa18b348c.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: patients with glaucoma; hypersensitivity to this medicine; patients predisposed to urinary retention (build-up of urine); elderly or debilitated people; newborns.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: patients with glaucoma or who may develop urinary retention; hyperchloraemic acidosis; renal failure.

Do not take this medicine together with MAO inhibitors, alcohol, or other central nervous system depressants.

If dizziness, nausea, rash, malaise, mental confusion, loss of appetite, or, rarely, headache, thirst, or metabolic acidosis occurs, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Used for loss of appetite
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Loss of appetite

d3f60492492fb5dc.title: S-Alpha Tablet
d3f60492492fb5dc.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for stomach discomfort, bloating, stomach pain, excess stomach acid, heartburn, acid reflux, overeating, food stagnation, indigestion, aiding digestion, loss of appetite, nausea, and vomiting.
d3f60492492fb5dc.usage:
People aged 15 years and over and adults: take 2 tablets at a time, 3 times daily, after meals.
Children aged 8 years to under 15 years: take 1 tablet at a time, 3 times daily, after meals.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
d3f60492492fb5dc.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: children aged 7 years and under.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: pregnant women and women who may be pregnant; patients with gastrointestinal disease, kidney disorder, or heart disorder; patients with glaucoma (eye pain, blurred vision) or urinary difficulty; patients with thyroid dysfunction or elderly people; patients with hypermagnesaemia; an allergic constitution or a history of allergic symptoms to medicines (rash, redness, itching). If symptoms do not improve after taking this medicine for about 2 weeks, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

When giving this medicine to a child, do so under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.

Do not take this medicine together with gastrointestinal analgesics or antispasmodics. Taken together with large amounts of milk or calcium preparations, milk-alkali syndrome (hypercalcaemia, azotaemia, alkalosis) may occur, so observe carefully and stop taking if such symptoms appear.

If allergic symptoms (rash, redness, itching), dry mouth, constipation or diarrhoea, headache, facial flushing, sensitivity to light, or difficulty passing urine occurs, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Relieves stomach discomfort, excess stomach acid, indigestion, and nausea
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Stomach discomfort, bloating, stomach pain, heartburn, indigestion, nausea
